intent.raw: See if anything in arcanum/ could be used here and whether we should create a sub-agent strategy for it. Anchor the remaining paper work to the publication-research-pipeline spell and fan out the gap phases (research-tower, research-evidence-harness, definitions-governance) to harden the evidence behind the updated DomainSpec paper.
intent.objective: Design a governed sub-agent route that anchors to the arcanum publication-research-pipeline spell and executes only its not-yet-done phases over the already-updated paper: build a source-backed learning tower (phase 2), produce dry-run-validated evidence run-schemas/fixtures for the hedged integrity flags and the E11 adjudication (phase 4), and canonicalize the load-bearing definitions with cross-copy drift checks (definitions-governance), feeding a claim-adjudication and research-readiness ledger without live runs or claim promotion.
intent.operator_sentence: Anchor to the publication-research-pipeline spell, recover the completed sweep and updated paper as inputs, then fan out three bounded lanes — a source-backed research tower, a dry-run evidence harness for the hedged claims, and a definitions-canon keeper — adjudicate which hedged flags can be promoted versus held, and hand off a research-readiness ledger, all without live experiment runs or claim promotion.

route_menu.context_hint: The route hardens evidence behind an already-updated paper. It is read-only plus dry-run validation; live experiment runs (e.g. E7) and any claim-status promotion require separate operator approval.

items.label: Publication-pipeline gap fanout
items.description: Anchor to publication-research-pipeline and fan out only its unfinished phases (tower, evidence-harness, definitions-governance) over the updated paper.

items.label: Evidence harness only
items.description: Run research-evidence-harness on just the two hedged integrity flags; cheaper but leaves source-tower and definitions drift unaddressed.

items.label: Definitions canon only
items.description: Lock DS-M13, the 25/29 counts, and E11 T-codes as canonical with cross-copy drift checks; narrowest scope.

items.label: Task session execution
items.description: Execute an approved readiness ledger as a bounded SWU (e.g. stage an E7 run package) once gates clear.

technique_overlays.trigger: The arcanum publication-research-pipeline spell already defines the owner lanes and gate model; this route must reuse them rather than re-invent a bespoke pipeline.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each lane maps to a named publication-research-pipeline phase (2, 4, or definitions support) and returns artifacts in that phase's owner lane without crossing into claim promotion or live execution.

technique_overlays.trigger: research-evidence-harness must validate schemas and fixtures only; evidence-status upgrades require live analysis, which this route does not perform.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The hedged flags (§6.5 signals, §8 counts, E11 adjudication) yield validated run-schemas and fixtures plus a promotion-readiness verdict; no claim status is changed and no live experiment is run.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The remaining publication-research-pipeline phases are owned by three distinct, independently-runnable sigils (research-tower, research-evidence-harness, definitions-governance) over separate evidence surfaces, and the prior fan-out already produced the source material they consume.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound lanes let each spell phase run in its own owner lane and return phase-scoped receipts, while a shared claim-adjudicator keeps the dry-run evidence and definitions canon from drifting into claim promotion or live execution.
context: The arcanum publication-research-pipeline spell (arcanum/spells/publication-research-pipeline/README.md) defines phases 2 (research-tower), 4 (research-evidence-harness), 6 (claim adjudication), 7 (paper rewrite) and an owner/gate model this route reuses.

Phases 1, 3, 5, 7 are already satisfied: ops/development/domainspec-paper-update-research-strategy.dispatch.json (route), ops/development/domainspec-paper-candidate-additions-brief.md (context/evidence sweep), and the updated research/projects/domainspec/papers/domainspec-paper.md (rewrite).

The audit left two integrity flags hedged because no artifact backs them: §6.5 signal-emission numbers (live telemetry empty, E7 not run) and §8 case-study counts (no independent experiment artifact).
E11's D4 gate passed only under a single-reviewer policy override; the claim matrix was deliberately left unchanged — a claim-adjudication question, not a rewrite question.
Two paper copies plus DEFINITIONS.md, TAXONOMY.md, and RELATIONSHIPS.md carry the 25/29 counts, DS-M13, and T01-T24 codes that must stay canonical and drift-checked.

roles.purpose: Run the research-tower phase: build source-first claims, a related-work map for §2, a notation bridge, and a residue ledger for the paper's C1-C4 and E6/E9/E11 evidence, keeping source claims separate from local inference.

Run research-evidence-harness in dry-run/validate mode: produce run-schemas, JSONL fixtures, and metric definitions for the §6.5 signal-rate (E7), §8 case-study counts, and E11 adjudication, with a promotion-readiness verdict and no live runs.

Run definitions-governance: canonicalize DS-M13, the 25/29 meta-type/edge counts, and the T01-T24 catalog, and drift-check them across both paper copies, DEFINITIONS.md, TAXONOMY.md, and RELATIONSHIPS.md.
Decide, from tower + harness + definitions receipts, which hedged flags are promotable, which stay insufficient, and what each requires (e.g. a live E7 run), without changing any claim status here.
Synthesize lane receipts into a research-readiness ledger keyed to publication-research-pipeline phases and a bounded next-route handoff.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run three bounded publication-research-pipeline lanes (research-tower, dry-run research-evidence-harness, definitions-governance) plus a claim-adjudicator over the updated paper to produce a research-readiness ledger, with no live experiment runs and no claim-status promotion?
receipt_requirement_notes: Each lane maps its output to a named publication-research-pipeline phase and owner lane.
Each lane returns concrete path evidence and classifies claims by evidence status.
The evidence-harness lane stays dry-run/validate only; no live experiment is executed.
No lane changes claim status or promotes inventory/ontology/glossary/sigil/spell artifacts.

steps.name: Anchor to the publication-research-pipeline spell and recover prior artifacts
stop_conditions: Map each planned lane to a publication-research-pipeline phase before any lane runs.
Treat phases 1, 3, 5, 7 as already satisfied by the prior dispatch, brief, and updated paper.
Keep the route read-only plus dry-run; live runs and promotions are out of scope.

steps.name: Phase 2 — build source-backed learning tower
convergence_criteria: Source-first claims for C1-C4 and E6/E9/E11 are separated from local inference with path evidence.
A related-work map covers the paper's §2 references and any uncited adjacent work surfaced from sources.
Residue and contradictions (e.g. E11 independence downgrade) are recorded, not resolved by inference.
stop_conditions: Block any source claim that collapses into local inference without a citation.
Flag any paper claim whose source the tower cannot locate.

steps.name: Phase 4 — dry-run evidence harness for hedged flags
convergence_criteria: §6.5 signal-rate, §8 counts, and E11 adjudication each receive a run-schema, fixtures, and metric definition.
Each hedged flag receives a promotion-readiness verdict: promotable-on-live-run, needs-protocol, or stays-insufficient.
No live experiment is executed and no claim status is changed.
stop_conditions: Block any move from dry-run validation to a live evidence-status upgrade.
Flag any flag whose fixtures cannot be schema-validated.

steps.name: Canonicalize definitions with cross-copy drift checks
convergence_criteria: DS-M13, the 25/29 meta-type/edge counts, and the T01-T24 catalog have one canonical definition each.
Drift is reported across both paper copies, DEFINITIONS.md, TAXONOMY.md, and RELATIONSHIPS.md with source paths.
Proposed-but-unadopted extensions (e.g. the ~38-edge study) are kept distinct from canonical counts.
stop_conditions: Block silent canonicalization of proposed extensions as if adopted.
Flag any term whose definition differs across the cited files.

steps.name: Phase 6 — adjudicate promotability without changing status
convergence_criteria: Each hedged flag and the E11 claim is classified: hold-insufficient, promotable-on-live-run, or definition-fix-only.
Every promotion path names the exact missing evidence (e.g. a live E7 run) and its owner.
No claim status is changed in this route.
stop_conditions: Flag any adjudication not backed by a harness or tower receipt.

steps.name: Synthesize research-readiness ledger keyed to spell phases
stop_conditions: Key every readiness item to a publication-research-pipeline phase and an owner.
Do not write canonical ontology/glossary/inventory promotions from the ledger.

steps.name: Validate evidence coverage and promotion guardrails
stop_conditions: Block if the ledger implies any live run or claim promotion was performed.
Flag any readiness item missing a phase, owner, or source path.

steps.name: Handoff next route under operator approval
stop_conditions: Live execution (e.g. an E7 run) or claim-status promotion requires explicit separate operator approval.
Export packaging (spell phase 8) remains a distinct, later decision.

gates.condition: This route is read-only plus dry-run validation; it produces strategy, tower, harness, definitions, and readiness artifacts but performs no live experiment run and no claim-status promotion.
research-evidence-harness stays in dry-run/validate mode; any evidence-status upgrade is deferred to a separately approved live run.
DS-M13, the 25/29 counts, and the T01-T24 catalog have one canonical definition each, with proposed extensions kept distinct from adopted counts.
No claim status is changed in this route; adjudication only classifies promotability and names missing evidence.
Recommended fan-out/subagent execution requires explicit user approval before delegated runtime work starts.
Lane receipts summarize findings only and do not promote inventory, ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell artifacts.

boundaries.contract: Each lane stays inside its spell-phase owner lane and returns phase-scoped receipts; the parent synthesis owns cross-lane interpretation.
Harness returns validated schemas and fixtures with a promotion-readiness verdict only; live runs and claim-status upgrades are out of scope.

boundaries.from_owner: DEFINITIONS.md, TAXONOMY.md, RELATIONSHIPS.md, both paper copies
boundaries.contract: Definitions are read and drift-reported; canonical files are not mutated by this route.

authority.lifecycle: dispatch-spec strategy artifact anchored to publication-research-pipeline
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validator plus research-evidence-harness dry-run checks
authority.evidence: path-cited repository artifacts, tower receipts, and validated fixtures
authority.memory: memory visibility only after separate user request

state_namespaces.write_policy: strategy, tower, harness, and readiness artifacts only

promotion_splits.target: claim status, inventory, ontology, glossary, sigil, and spell artifacts
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may be summarized as readiness input only; claim-status upgrade and canonical promotion require live analysis and separate approval.
Memory updates, if requested later, do not imply canonical knowledge promotion.

promotion_guardrails: The route does not claim promotion authority for Inventory, Ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell artifacts.
The route does not change any claim status; it only classifies promotability and names missing evidence.
The route does not run live experiments; research-evidence-harness stays in dry-run/validate mode.
The route reuses publication-research-pipeline phase owners rather than re-inventing a bespoke pipeline.
